notes.title: HEMOHOUND joins the Boomstock 2025 lineup!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We are extremely happy about this as HEMOHOUND is taking part in this edition of Boomstock. The showcase will feature a brand new trailer for the game and we will also be launching our Playtest Demo today! Proper for a celebration of this caliber.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517638/c23a9f85e59d627d61fdb85d19f80129be9e6435.png"][/img][/p][p]This event will run from September 23 to Septmeber 27 so be sure to check it out![/p][p]-Julio & Raymundo[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Boomstock2025"]Boomstock Event Page[/url][/p]

notes.title: HEMOHOUND joins the Mexican Entertainment System event!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We are very excited to share that we're taking part in this edition of the Mexican Entertainment System. This showcase is a celebration of mexican talent and we hope everyone can check it out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517638/0ce2720823bded3d04d96fb2d3ef62f21dc950e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This event will run from September 15 to September 22 so don't miss out if you find it interesting![/p][p]-Julio & Raymundo[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/mexicanentertainmentsystem2025"]MES Event Page[/url][/p][p][/p]
